parsed.observations: Grass specimens with cylindrical, bristly seedheads rather than typical wheat spikes. Leaves show tan-brown necrotic patches with dark specks; stems and sheaths have elongated reddish-brown discoloration. Distinct raised pustules or torn epidermis are not clearly resolved.
parsed.summary: The specimens appear to be non-wheat grasses with necrotic lesions, but the visible evidence does not reliably establish any allowed wheat disease.
